description: Rough opening width and height for a list of windows and doors from the unit sizes and the side, top and sill gaps you enter, one printable row per opening. Source: Arithmetic on the unit size and gaps you enter; the manufacturer rough opening table for each unit governs.

lines.description: Comma separated label:unit_width_in:unit_height_in:gap_each_side_in:gap_top_in:gap_sill_in:quantity, for example W1:36:48:0.5:0.5:0.75:2,D1:36:80:0.5:0.5:0.5:1. Sizes and gaps are in inches. No gap is assumed; take each from the unit installation instructions.
